descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S26 Save & Extract after placement: the placed box is what gets extracted, and only then do tasks appear

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Assigning does not create tasks, record medication events, or generate a note. Those happen only when the physician opens that patient's Encounter tab and taps Save & Extract. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 7)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given QA Hosp Patel (415), empty chart, no tasks; ai/parsing:extractTasks and ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents answered by fixed mockResponses through e2e/support/action-observer.ts

When Place 'Bed 415. Recheck BMP in the morning. Task: call daughter at 5 pm.' with Link; read the patient through the API; open Patel's Encounter tab (opened after placement) and tap Save & Extract

Then Before the tap: the patient's tasks are [] and no ai/parsing:* request was sent. After the tap: encounterNotes still holds the box text exactly; the extractTasks request's content includes 'Recheck BMP in the morning'; the code-word task 'call daughter at 5 pm' appears now, verbatim

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: tasks toEqual([]) after quickDictation:assign and zero ai/parsing:* requests before the tap (U7: assign extracts nothing, not even the model-free code word); after Save & Extract encounterNotes toBe the box text (U2), the recorded extractTasks request content contains 'Recheck BMP in the morning' (U7: Save & Extract is where extraction happens, on the pl …

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-04/S26

Save & Extract after placement: the placed box is what gets extracted, and only then do tasks appear

Tickets: TFA-92582 Quick Dictation (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-b: status passed in newspec-b/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Chromium spec on a fresh account: QA Hosp Patel (415); record every action over the socket; place the box with Link; API read: tasks == [] and zero ai/parsing:* before the tap; open Encounter, Save & Extract with extractTasks / extractMedicationEvents answered by fixed mocks at the socket; assert encounterNotes == box text, the extractTasks request content contains 'Recheck BMP in the morning', a task 'call daughter at 5 pm' exists. — Socket-level mocks (qa-agent copy of action-observer) make the model calls deterministic; no model is reached.

Detail:

After Link: tasks [] and no ai/parsing:* request. After Save & Extract: encounterNotes is the box text exactly, the extractTasks request content is 'Bed 415. Recheck BMP in the morning.' (code-word clause stripped, as designed), tasks = 'call daughter at 5 pm' (verbatim code word) + 'Recheck BMP in the morning'. Both AI actions answered at the socket.

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
